command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$j = Get-Content 'C:\Users\bs\p40-commissioning\evidence\rollback-ollama-inspect.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$c = $j[0]
$o = [ordered]@{
  Name=$c.Name; Id=$c.Id; Created=$c.Created; Image=$c.Config.Image; ImageId=$c.Image
  State=$c.State; RestartPolicy=$c.HostConfig.RestartPolicy; DeviceRequests=$c.HostConfig.DeviceRequests
  Devices=$c.HostConfig.Devices; Binds=$c.HostConfig.Binds; Mounts=$c.Mounts
  PortBindings=$c.HostConfig.PortBindings; ExposedPorts=$c.Config.ExposedPorts
  Env=$c.Config.Env; Cmd=$c.Config.Cmd; Entrypoint=$c.Config.Entrypoint
  Labels=$c.Config.Labels; NetworkMode=$c.HostConfig.NetworkMode; Runtime=$c.HostConfig.Runtime
  Networks=($c.NetworkSettings.Networks.PSObject.Properties.Name)
}
$o | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
Write-Output '--- IMAGE ---'
$i = Get-Content 'C:\Users\bs\p40-commissioning\evidence\rollback-ollama-image-inspect.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
[ordered]@{ Id=$i[0].Id; RepoTags=$i[0].RepoTags; RepoDigests=$i[0].RepoDigests; Created=$i[0].Created } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
Write-Output "LASTEXITCODE=$LASTEXITCODE"
